key_insight: QG-MIL is a gated transformer MIL aggregator that reduces attention concentration so instance importance is spread more evenly and predictions are more stable.
clinical_relevance: It may improve reliability of pathology and hematology AI systems that summarize many image patches or cells into one case-level prediction.
method: Per-head QK normalization plus fine-grained attention output gating
SwiGLU-style feed-forward layers in a transformer-based MIL aggregator
evidence_signal: Evaluated on six benchmarks across whole-slide pathology and cell-level hematology, with the best variants outperforming baselines on all six and averaging +6.1 macro F1 points.
watch_item: Performance is benchmark-dependent, and the full benefit may require careful tuning of the configurable components across different MIL datasets.
paper_title: QG-MIL: A Gated Transformer Aggregator for Domain-Agnostic Multiple Instance Learning in Medical Imaging
